_meta.description: The Associates tracking ID selected by the site owner, and the rules this site applies to it. The ID is owner-supplied input (brief of 2026-11-17); whether it is registered, active and assigned to this site can only be confirmed inside Associates Central.

tracking_id.format_matches: XXXXX-## pattern per Participation Requirements 2(b) (source S-POL)
tracking_id.registered_and_active: unconfirmed (FLG-04) - confirm in Associates Central before treating any link as attribution-ready

link_rules: Every outbound link to an Amazon site on this site is the final destination URL plus the tag parameter - no link shortener, no obscure redirects (Participation Requirements 2(b), 6(v), 6(w)).
Every outbound Amazon link carries rel="sponsored" and the disclosure adjacency required by the FTC guidance (source S-FTC).
P4/P5 links are never published while held (FLG-06).
Attribution for any link is unverified until the one-link-per-product test passes in the enrolled Associates workflow (FLG-07).

No price, availability, star rating, review count or popularity badge is displayed from Amazon pages: Participation Requirement 2(b) allows those only when Amazon serves the content or it comes through the Creators/PA API, neither of which is connected (carried rule, F-02/F-37 there).
